summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing complete. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests pass (37 regression + 3 new TestGetSeed tests covering GET /api/security/seed → returns 12-word phrase for fresh wallet, 401 without auth, 400 after backup). All existing flows (auth, wallet, market, rewards, bills, security verify/PIN/biometric) remain green. Frontend: full end-to-end coverage on mobile viewport 480x900 of every iter-3 change — Success page renders correctly for all five kinds (sent/paid/redeemed/backed_up/claimed) with cursive verb, eyebrow, amount, receipt lines, primary + secondary CTAs, animated checkmark. Backup direct-URL fix confirmed (hits /api/security/seed and renders 12-word grid when opened via /home backup-banner or direct URL). Backup verify → /success kind=backed_up (+250 coins). Send full flow (addr+amt+tier+PIN) → /success with txid/fee/total receipt. Bills flow → /success kind=paid with biller/account/btc-spent/new-balance. Rewards claim → /success kind=claimed (+125 coins, day-2 streak). Store list items carry data-testid='store-item-{id}' and route to /store/:id. StoreItem detail page: hero card uses Starbucks green brand color, cursive brand name, tagline, coin balance with after-redeem calc (shows 'insufficient' when under-funded; shows '100' when 1300 coins minus 1200 cost). Redeem (when affordable) → /success kind=redeemed with 12-char voucher code. Home action-grid 'history' → /transactions. Category pills route to /store?cat=food|travel|shop|play with filter applied (food pill shows only starb-250). Health/Rent → /bills. Scan chip → /scan with viewfinder + animated overlay + manual paste; pasting 42-char address enables 'continue' → /send pre-filled. All pages use Header with back arrow and Shell bottom-nav where applicable. Italianno cursive headings consistent across Success and StoreItem.

issues: Defaults to kind='sent' ('TRANSACTION · BROADCASTED → sent.') rather than redirecting to /home or showing a neutral empty-state. Minor — users rarely hit /success directly, but consider a graceful redirect when location.state is missing.

action_items: (Optional polish) On /success with no navigation state, redirect to /home (or render a neutral 'nothing to show' state) instead of defaulting to 'sent'.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: GET /api/security/seed correctly blocks after backup (400) and backfills missing seed for legacy wallets — well-handled. seed_phrase still hidden from /wallet/me projection (verified).

Frontend Success.jsx is reused across 5 kinds via location.state; reasonable for a single animated component but without state it renders misleading 'sent' fallback — consider useEffect guard with nav('/home') when state is null.
StoreItem.jsx insufficient-coins UX is clean: 'NOT ENOUGH COINS' disabled button + 'earn more coins →' link (voucher-earn-more testid) routes to /rewards.
server.py has grown to 519 lines with iter-3 additions; splitting into routers (auth, wallet, market, rewards, security) still recommended for maintainability.
generate_seed_phrase still uses random.choice (with replacement) → duplicates observed (2–3 'access' or 'marble' per phrase). Acceptable for mock; flag for production BIP39 compliance.

Home action-grid fix verified: the former 'more' slot is now 'history' (home-history testid) routing to /transactions. Category pills (cat-food/travel/shop/play) pass ?cat=… and Store filters correctly. Health/Rent correctly route to /bills.
test_credentials: Fresh wallets created per run via POST /api/auth/register {name:'TestFlow|Rew|Redeem|...', pin:'112233'}.
seed_data_creation: To enable voucher redeem test (starb-250 costs 1200, starting coins 1000), booster call: POST /api/bills/pay {biller:'Boost',account:'X',amount_usd:30} → +300 coins (1000→1300).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 is fully functional. 40 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_api.py. For backup-verify Playwright flow: use shuffled-N and target seed-word-N testids; match by first-unused-shuffled-with-matching-text — duplicates in seed mean you must track used ids. Success page testids: success-screen, success-headline, success-amount, success-cta, success-secondary. StoreItem testids: voucher-hero, voucher-balance, voucher-redeem-btn, voucher-earn-more. Scan testids: scan-viewfinder, scan-gallery, scan-manual, scan-manual-input, scan-continue.
